title: The Last Portrait
author: Quentin Oyelaran
blurb: Astrid Delacroix, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the well refills.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
